notes.title: The Demo Is Available (Again)
notes.notes:
The demo for Eidolon Awakened is once again live and ready to play. We've spent the past few months  improving the demo thanks to all the feedback we've collected so I'd like to extend a massive thank you to everyone who provided feedback from the previous Demo or the playtest.

[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] A ton of bugfixes.
[*] Combat AI improvements and fine-tuning.
[*] New core systems such as Eidolon Friendship and Fortes.
[*] UI/UX improvements.
[*] Presentation improvements.
[*] Rebalanced certain aspects of the game such as combat and Eidolon encounters.
[/list]

notes.title: Two Weeks Playtest
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

notes.title: Eidolon Awakened - Major Demo Update (v0.3.4)
notes.notes:
As I mentioned in the first DevLog, the updated demo includes a ton of quality of life changes, plus some new content in the form of new social events, areas and Eidolons. I've also implemented proper gamepad support.

[u][b]Quality of Life:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Gamepad is now properly supported, however there will be more improvements for Gamepad controls in the near future.
[*] Added a virtual keyboard for name inputs.
[*] Added a new auto-save feature that can be configured from the settings menu.
[*] Added a new notification for saving the game.
[*] You can now purchase multiple items at once from shops.
[*] Added a new notification that lists people of interest as you approach an area in the overworld.
[*] Added skip dialogue functionality, pressing the Confirm button will instantly complete the message being written in the dialogue box.
[/list]

[u][b]General:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added two new areas to the overworld: Lower Arcadia City and Wasteland Sanctuary.
[*] Added the Fortune Teller which allows you to change your name and nickname your Eidolons.
[*] Added four new Social events.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493245/fe6788d710c2e4375450e1208f6659fec575268b.gif[/img]

[u][b]Battle System:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Negative Status Effects now interact with the target's Affliction affinity resistance. Weakness to Affliction will increase the chance for the status effect to be applied, while Resist, Null or Drain to Affliction will reduce it.
[*] The Daze status effect was changed to a 25% accuracy penalty to all Physical abilities.
[*] The Languid status effect was changed to only raise the MP cost of Special abilities. (Energize and Free Action still affect all ability types.)
[*] Added a visual indicator for the duration of a timed status effect.
[*] When applying a timed status effect that already exists on the target, the duration of the status effect will instead be refreshed when possible.
[*] The damage calculation formula has been adjusted to make Endurance and Resistance more effective.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493245/09b3eafe70331827f43bf91e9f747ee01fd26f36.gif[/img]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an inconsistency with Fortify, Power, Frail and Weaken and damage calculation.
[*] Fixed some collision errors on the Overworld.
[*] Fixed a bunch of audio related issues.
[*] Fixed an issue with item drop tables not being calculated correctly.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493245/dc82c31130d595131a0ae78e06bc026b0e059589.gif[/img]

notes.title: Eidolon Awakened Dev Log #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Although we've been very busy making progress with the main story - we've also got a bunch of new features and quality of life improvements planned for the Demo, thanks to all the feedback we've received from you. We plan to update the demo in the following month to include the following quality of life improvements.

[h2][b]UI/UX:[/b][/h2]
[b]User Interface navigation[/b] was a big pain point for players so it will receive some major improvements. For starters, you'll be able to flip between different user interface pages just by navigating left or right. This should make browsing your inventory, summoning program or even the shops much easier. We will also add the option to specify an amount when purchasing an item.

[b]The Eidolon Storage[/b] interface will also received a major overhaul. You can now easily navigate between pages of your stored eidolons and can directly swap Eidolons from your party into storage or vice versa, without having to deposit and withdraw. You will also have access to more information about your Eidolons through the storage interface as it will now display the Eidolon's attributes, resistances, potential and both features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493245/5a62ef608812cb82de65af377a669f7284b6ff23.png[/img]

Finally, we're adding a new notification to the overworld user interface that will show you important NPCs that can be found in an area.

[h2][b]System:[/b][/h2]
[b]An auto-save feature[/b] will also be included in the demo update. It can be configured to save whenever you enter a new area or after each battle, or alternatively it can be entirely disabled.

[h2][b]Gameplay:[/b][/h2]
[b]Status effects[/b] have also received some major quality of life changes, with visual indicators for duration and proper support for duration stacking. Furthermore, some status effects have been reworked.

There are also plans to include [b]additional content[/b] in the Demo, such as access to new Socials, side quests, a bunch of new Eidolons to acquire and even brand new areas to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493245/bbf889ba2babff6fee9a1987f8a3408a910c92a7.gif[/img]

Finally, the Demo update will include a bunch of minor bugs we've identified and fixed such as collision issues in the overworld, item drop table errors, audio and graphical issues.

[b]Gamepad Support:[/b]
We plan to include at least partial gamepad support for Eidolon Awakened in the near future, however it's not certain whether or not this will be included in the Demo update yet. We are however aware that many of you would like to use a Gamepad as much as possible. We're also looking into improving the player experience with the Steam Deck.

I'd like to thank everyone who tried out the demo and submitted feedback, your input has been extremely helpful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44493245/67be9ea69f4fd1d45c6305e0c0693086d90d4084.gif[/img]

notes.title: Eidolon Awakened demo is now live!
notes.notes:
Eidolon Awakened is going to be part of Steam Next Fest June 2024! The demo is now publicly available to everyone and will remain accessible after Next Fest.

The demo is estimated to have a few hours worth of content as it contains content up to the fourth Main Mission. It also includes a large variety of Eidolons to collect and experiment with.

If you'd like to share your feedback on the demo or discuss the game itself you can join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/EwQnC3PD3z

notes.title: Eidolon Awakened Demo v0.3.1
notes.notes:
This is a minor patch primarily containing bug fixes but also certain adjustments to Eidolons and Abilities. 

[u]General:[/u]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased ECT drop rate.
[*] All Data Cache treasure has been revised.
[*] Lighting has been adjusted throughout the game.
[/list]

[u]Missions:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added a new side mission [Once Upon a Time in the Wasteland].
[*] [Lost and Found] side mission has received a re-write.
[/list]

[u]Eidolons:[/u]
[list]
[*] Certain Eidolons have had their names changed.
[*] Spilight feature has been reworked: Pixie Dust - Applying a positive status effect also restores a small amount of health to your target.
[*] Qiwi feature has been reworked: Aura Boost - Your Psychic damage is increased by 30% while Fortify is active.
[/list]

[u]Abilities:[/u]
[list]
[*] [Passive] Health Adept now raises Max Health by 10% instead of a flat amount.
[*] [Passive] Health Expertise now raises Max Health by 20% instead of a flat amount.
[*] [Passive] Attribute Tuner I passives now raise their respective attribute by 10% instead of +5.
[*] [Passive] Universal Tuner I now raises all attributes by 5% instead of +2.
[/list]

[u]Bug Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed mismatching body sprites.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused missing cutscene NPCs after retrying the boss fight in Facility 11.
[*] Fixed certain music tracks ignoring the volume slider and fading out incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where collecting 100% Eidolon Data would not automatically unlock the Eidolon's Resistances and Potential information.
[*] Fixed an issue with the broken vending machine in the Eidolon Settlement.
[*] Fixed an incorrect map transition for Arcadia Terminal.
[*] Fixed an issue with the way attribute multipliers were calculated.
[*] Social Rapport increase events now properly increment past Rank 1.
[/list]
